== 40% ==
5 May 2025 is known as square root day. The previous square root day was in 2016. In which month did it occur?

'''APRIL''': Square root day occurs when the date and the month number are identical and multiply together to make the last two digits of the year. 5 x 5 = 25 and 4 x 6 = 16

== 1% ==
What number sequence replaces the question mark?

ONE = 321<br>TWO = 231<Br>FOUR = 1243<Br>EIGHT = 14235<Br>FORTY = '''12345'''

The numbers indicate the order the letters come alphabetically. The letters in FORTY are in alphabetical order so the answer is '''12345'''.
